checks.message: RC5 plan must be positioned at RC5-021 with RC5-020 completed and RC5-021 pending before this proof.
Hosted mirror service framework must be passed, metadata-only, DNS-override-verified, and authority-free.
Hosted endpoint verifier must be passed, non-GA, blocker-free, and record TLS as a GA gate.
Hosted metadata fail-closed fixtures must reject all negative cases.
Mirror frontend must remain static, dependency-free, non-authoritative, and served.
User release channel projection must be passed, metadata-only, and block install/update.
User release result must remain hash-bound to bootstrap, user channel, and hosted channel local outputs.
Bootstrap manifest must require rollback baseline and exact operator approval before canary, while carrying no authority.
User channel must keep release payload unavailable and install/update blocked.

evidence.reason: RC5 publishes metadata and bootstrap checks only; payload, signatures, rollback execution, TLS GA gate, and canary evidence are pending.

checks.message: Hosted channel must stay metadata-only, hash-bound to RC4 final audit, and advertise no activation/signing/rollback authority.
Live hosted endpoints must return HTTP 200 through curl --resolve and remain non-GA/non-authoritative.
RC4 staged rollout smoke must be passed, exact-approval-gated, non-executable, and mutation-free.
RC4 rollout projection must remain approval-required, non-executable, and blocked by design.
Fleet authority must remain AgentCore/SecurityExecution-only, with remote canary/staging/production execution blocked.
RC5 proof must require at least two enrolled canary target nodes before execution and must not fake enrollment.
Controlled canary execution must remain blocked until exact approval, multi-node enrollment, and remote fleet execution are enabled through the correct authority path.
Canary projection must bind RC5 hosted/user-channel evidence, RC4 rollout evidence, rollback readiness, and fleet authority.
Rollback readiness projection must reuse the RC4 rollback baseline, keep previous/restored hashes equal, and execute no rollback.
RC5 canary proof must not sign, upload, activate, execute rollback, mutate registry/slot/ring state, dispatch remotely, or grant TUI/model/shell authority.
